name: phone-input
blurb: Phone input with a searchable country selector and flag icons.
description: A phone number input using react-phone-number-input with a popover country selector featuring flag icons, search capability, and calling codes.
use_when: Building international forms where users need to select their country and enter validated phone numbers.
avoid_when: When single-country phone inputs suffice or when space for a country selector is unavailable.
a11y: Country selector is keyboard accessible with arrow keys and search, flag icons have country name titles.
